scripts.build: pnpm --filter @web-tools/toolkit run build && pnpm --filter @web-tools/api run build && pnpm --filter @web-tools/cli run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @web-tools/toolkit run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test:py:coverage: pnpm run test:py:coverage:scrapling && pnpm run test:py:coverage:camoufox
scripts.test:py:coverage:scrapling: python3 -m coverage run --data-file=.coverage-scrapling --source=services/scrapling --omit='*/test_*' -m unittest discover -s services/scrapling -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m coverage report --data-file=.coverage-scrapling
scripts.test:py:coverage:camoufox: python3 -m coverage run --data-file=.coverage-camoufox --source=services/camoufox --omit='*/test_*' -m unittest discover -s services/camoufox -p 'test_form*.py' && python3 -m coverage report --data-file=.coverage-camoufox
